title: 8.1.2 Lab: Your First Box
description: Add your first box in reSHape and set its size in the Dimensions panel. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Add a box
steps.instructions: Press the Box tool in the toolbar (the cube icon), then click anywhere in the 3D view to place it.
hints: The Box tool's tooltip reads "Add a box" when you hover it.
A box appears at the center once you click in the 3D view.

steps.title: Set its size in the Dimensions panel
steps.instructions: With the box selected, look at the Dimensions panel on the right. Type 40 in width, 40 in depth, and 20 in height.
hints: The box may already show 40, 40, and 20 — that's fine, those are the numbers you want. Type them in to be sure.
Each field has a slider above it and a number box below it. Click the number box and type to change it exactly.

requirements.title: A 40 x 40 x 20 mm box
requirements.description: The part is a single box, 40 mm wide, 40 mm deep, and 20 mm tall.
requirements.hint: Press the Box tool, click in the 3D view, then check that width, depth, and height read 40, 40, 20 in the Dimensions panel.
